subtitle: An urban beach beside Thiruvananthapuram's airport, measured eroding by the meter and cut off from its own access road by the sea it faces.
spike_statement: Erosion measured at 4.73 meters a year swallowed the only easy road to Trivandrum airport, forcing passengers to walk in with their luggage.

levers.photo_tone: Cracked asphalt and rubble against a flat gray Arabian Sea, the white mermaid sculpture a small bright shape in the distance
